name: Hearthstone Firearms Guardian-12 'Bedside'
description:
The Hearthstone Guardian-12 is a double-action semi-automatic pistol chambered in .380 ACP, designed and marketed specifically for home defense in the Gray Zone and lower-Mid residential blocks. The frame is oversized for the caliber, making it easy to grip with shaking or untrained hands. The trigger pull in double-action mode is deliberately heavy at 5.5kg to prevent negligent discharge.

The Guardian-12 ships with a built-in trigger lock, a loaded chamber indicator visible in darkness through a tritium-painted port, and an instruction manual written at a fourth-grade reading level in fourteen languages. Hearthstone designed every aspect of this weapon for people who have never held a gun before and hope they never have to fire one. The heavy trigger, the visible chamber indicator, the oversized grip — all of it prioritizes safety over performance.

The Bedside is the best-selling firearm in the Gray Zone residential districts. Families keep them in nightstand drawers and kitchen cabinets, loaded with hollow-point rounds that Hearthstone bundles in the box. It is not a weapon for professionals. It is a weapon for parents who heard gunshots last night and decided they needed something between themselves and the door.
specifications: caliber: .380 ACP effective_range: 12 meters rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic (double-action) magazine_capacity: 10 rounds weight: 0.62 kg
tactical_use: A home defense weapon designed for untrained users at close range. The heavy trigger and low-powered caliber reduce the risk of negligent discharge and over-penetration through residential walls. Effective only against unarmored targets at room distance. Not suitable for any tactical application requiring speed, accuracy, or stopping power against determined attackers.
cultural_context: The Guardian-12 represents the quiet fear that runs through the Gray Zone residential life. Families don't talk about having one, but surveys suggest nearly one in three the Gray Zone households contains a Bedside. It is a weapon born from resignation — the understanding that no one is coming to help if something happens at three in the morning.
story_hooks: A child fires a Guardian-12 during a break-in and kills an intruder who turns out to be a corponation employee on a sanctioned operation. The legal fallout threatens to consume an entire the Gray Zone block.
Hearthstone is offering a trade-in program for Guardian-12s — but the traded weapons aren't being destroyed. They're being shipped somewhere.
physical_description: The Guardian-12 is a blocky, utilitarian pistol with an oversized polymer frame in matte black or gunmetal grey, designed to sit comfortably in untrained hands. Its slide bears faded Hearthstone branding and a small tritium sight port that glows faint green in darkness. The frame shows minor scuffs and wear from residential shelves, with a stubby barrel and a visible trigger lock mechanism that suggests cautious ownership.
